 Terry Duguid 
 · Minister of Environment and Climate change 
 Description 
In the exercise of my official duties as the Minister of Sport and Minister Responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada , I recused myself on March 6, 2025, from any discussion, decision, debate or vote on a Governor in Council nomination process in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment and any opportunity to further the private interests of my friend, Mr. Christian L.
